Why this site exists

Editorial methodology

The site is published as a lightweight static reference for generative engine optimization, traditional SEO and fast bot crawling. There is no client-side rendering and no JavaScript dependency for core content.

Definitions and phraseology references are sourced from ICAO Doc 9432 and the FAA Pilot/Controller Glossary, then organized into crawlable HTML pages for aviation professionals, students and exam candidates.
